name: Test of Lore
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You have passed Dorn's tests, and now you seek to pass your next trial. Very good. But up until now, your challenges have been childish. It is easy to test your body--your mind is another matter completely.

I shall explain it simply: find the book I name, study it, and answer my question about its contents.

What book, you must be asking? The Legacy of the Aspects. It can be found at the bottom of Dor'danil in southern Ashenvale, protected by the dead druids and their slayers.
narrative.objectives: Find the Legacy of the Aspects and return it to Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This is the book I named. There is hope you will answer my question correctly then... unless you've forgotten to study its contents.

When you are prepared, speak to me again and I shall ask a question of you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Bring me the book after you've studied it. I will not ask you your question until after you have given me the book.
